description: Demolition of a pair of semi-detached houses; construction of a three storey building to provide six self-contained flats ( 4 X 2 beds and 2 x 1 bed), with 4 integral parking spaces to the rear of the building; new vehicle access from Hooking Green, communal amenity space, hard surfacing, landscaping, boundary treatment, bin and cycle storage
decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;
text-justify:inter-ideograph;text-indent:-18.0pt;line-height:normal;mso-pagination:
widow-orphan;mso-list:l0 level1 lfo1"><!--[if !supportLists]--><span style="font-size:12.0pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:
Arial">1.<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
</span></span><!--[endif]--><span style="font-size:12.0pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">The
proposed Flats E and F, by reason of their failure to provide sufficient
internal floor space which meets the minimum internal floor-to-ceiling height
and lack of private<span style="color:#80340D;mso-themecolor:accent2;
mso-themeshade:128"> </span>amenity space, would give rise to a substandard and
poor quality accommodation to the detriment of the residential amenities of
future occupiers of the flats; while the proposal fails to demonstrate adequate
accessibility for all future occupiers, contrary to the National Planning
Policy Framework (2024), policies D5 and D6 of The London Plan (2021), Policy
CS1.K of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), Policies DM1, DM2 and DM27 of the
Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013), the Mayor of London Housing
Design Standards London Plan Guidance (June 2023) and the adopted Supplementary
Planning Documents Residential Design Guide (2010<span style="color:#80340D;
mso-themecolor:accent2;mso-themeshade:128">).&nbsp;<o:p></o:p></span></span></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;
text-justify:inter-ideograph;text-indent:-18.0pt;line-height:normal;mso-pagination:
widow-orphan;mso-list:l0 level1 lfo1"><!--[if !supportLists]--><span style="font-size:12.0pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:
Arial">1.<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
</span></span><!--[endif]--><span style="font-size:12.0pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">The
proposed vehicle access, by reason of its excessive width and the reliance of
the parking arrangements on this access to be functional, would be likely to
result in harmful impacts on the safety of the local highway, and in particular
on pedestrian safety. The proposal is therefore considered to be contrary to
policy T4 of the London Plan (2021) and Policy DM42 of the Harrow Development
Management Policies Local Plan (2013).<o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;
text-justify:inter-ideograph;text-indent:-18.0pt;line-height:normal;mso-pagination:
widow-orphan;mso-list:l0 level1 lfo1"><!--[if !supportLists]--><span style="font-size:12.0pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:
Arial">1.<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
</span></span><!--[endif]--><span style="font-size:12.0pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">The
proposal, by reason of the site being located within an area of land liable to
flooding, and insufficient information within the submitted Flood Risk
Assessment &nbsp;in relation to compensatory
flood storage, the proposed site levels and surface water flood depths, has
failed to demonstrate that the proposed development would not exacerbate the
risk of flooding within the site or increase the risk and consequences of
flooding elsewhere. The proposal would thereby be contrary to the to the
National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy SI 12.C of the London Plan
(2021), Policy CS 1 U of the Harrow Core Strategy and Policies DM9 and DM10 of
the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013).</span><span style="font-size:12.0pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:
&quot;Times New Roman&quot;"><o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="line-height: normal;">The
proposal, by virtue of its inappropriate roof form, in combination with the height,
scale and footprint of the building, and the site’s corner location, would result
in an incongruous, bulky, visually intrusive
and over dominant development, which would be overbearing and prominent in the streetscene
to the detriment of the character and appearance of the development and the streetscene
and the pattern of development within the surrounding area and would therefore
be contrary to the high quality design aspirations of the National Planning
Policy Framework (2024), Policies D3.D(1) and D3.D(11) of The London Plan
(2021), Policy CS.1B of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), Policy DM1 of the
Development Management Plan Local Policies (2013) and the adopted Supplementary
Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010).<span style="font-size:12.0pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:
&quot;Times New Roman&quot;"> <o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;
text-justify:inter-ideograph;text-indent:-18.0pt;line-height:normal;mso-pagination:
widow-orphan;mso-list:l0 level1 lfo1"><!--[if !supportLists]--><span style="font-size:12.0pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:
Arial">1.<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
</span></span><!--[endif]--><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">Insufficient information has been provided with regard to ground
levels to enable the Local Planning Authority to determine whether the proposed
development is capable of being carried out at suitable levels in relation to
the highway and adjoining properties, and to not result in harm to the amenity
of neighbouring residents, the appearance of the development, increased
displacement of surface and flood water, and functionality with regard to the
gradient of all accesses and entrances, as well as failing to demonstrate
adequate accessibility for the development, &nbsp;contrary to Policy D5 of the London Plan
(2021), policy CS1 B, U and K of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012) and Policies
DM1 and DM2 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013).</span><span style="font-size:12.0pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:
&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;color:#80340D;mso-themecolor:accent2;mso-themeshade:128"><o:p></o:p></span></p>
